_readme: Maps doc ROLES (the vocabulary skills speak in) to the actual paths in THIS project. Full role vocabulary and the exit-code contract: plugins/backend-suite/docs/DOC-ROLES.md. readme.md is the entry point and the only fully-authored doc: a library's public API surface is documented there. The other five roles (api-standard, changelog, contributing, decisions, deprecations) map to stubs scaffolded 2026-10-11 — resolve exits 5 for them (registered, unwritten) until the DECIDE markers are answered. App/org-shaped roles (brief, backlog, builds, deployment, production-readiness) are declined with reasons; the rest are unmapped, which makes a skill stop and ask rather than guess.

brief.declined: jikan is a client library with no external-facing product brief; the README's 'About' is the closest thing and covers it

backlog.declined: no internal work-tracking backlog document kept in-repo; issues/roadmap live on GitHub

builds.declined: no build orchestration to document: standard Composer install; no bundling/build step

deployment.declined: publishing a Composer library is a Packagist tag; no deployment process document needed

production-readiness.declined: internal readiness checklists are for service operators; a client-facing library has no production posture to checklist
